question: Who has been conferred with the Grand Cross of the Order of Honour by the President of Greece in August 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Narendra Modi and highlight this line.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Narendra Modi was awarded the **Grand Cross of the Order of Honour by the President of Greece,** Katerina Sakellaropoulou, in August 2023.
 
• This honor is one of the highest civilian awards in Greece, recognizing significant contributions to the country or** international relations.**
 
• It also acknowledges his role in promoting global peace and cooperation.

• **Piyush Goyal** is the current **Minister of Commerce and Industry, Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, and Textiles in the Government of India.**
 
• **Jagdeep Dhankhar** is the current **Vice President of India**, having assumed office in August 2022.
 
• **Om Birla is the Speaker of the Lok Sabha,** the lower house of India’s Parliament, since June 2019.
